title: 2013 Dodge Dart OEM Owner's & Service Manual Knowledge Base

factual_data.engine_oil_specification: 2013 Dodge Dart 1.4L Turbo MultiAir strictly requires API SN / ACEA C3 SAE 5W-40 Full Synthetic oil meeting Chrysler Material Standard MS-12991 (recommended Pennzoil Platinum Euro or Mopar). Total capacity with oil filter is 4.0 quarts (3.8 liters). MultiAir hydraulic actuators rely directly on oil viscosity for variable intake valve timing.
factual_data.oil_change_indicator_reset: To reset the 'Oil Change Due' dash light: 1. Turn ignition switch to ON/RUN without starting the engine. 2. Fully depress the accelerator pedal slowly 3 times within 10 seconds. 3. Turn ignition OFF. If message returns on restart, repeat procedure.
factual_data.spark_plugs_and_gap: Spark Plugs: NGK SIKR9A7 (Laser Iridium), pre-gapped to 0.026 in (0.65 mm). Service interval is 30,000 miles (48,000 km) for the 1.4L Turbo. Spark plug torque: 13 to 15 ft-lbs (18 to 20 Nm). Never use non-iridium plugs in the MultiAir engine.
factual_data.tire_pressures_and_tpms: Cold tire pressure recommendation: 34 PSI (234 kPa) front and rear for stock sizes (225/45R17 or 205/55R16). Compact spare tire pressure: 60 PSI (414 kPa). Wheel lug nut torque spec: 100 ft-lbs (135 Nm). The TPMS auto-learns new sensor IDs after driving above 15 mph for ~10-15 minutes.
factual_data.engine_coolant_antifreeze: Coolant type: Mopar Antifreeze/Coolant 10 Year/150,000 Mile Formula OAT (Organic Additive Technology) meeting Chrysler MS-12106. Capacity is 6.5 quarts (6.1 liters). Never mix with older HOAT or conventional green coolants; mixing causes gel precipitation and water pump failure.
factual_data.transmission_fluids: Manual 6-Speed (Fiat C635): Capacity 1.8 quarts (1.7 L) of Mopar C635 manual transmission lubricant (SAE 75W, API GL-4). Dual Dry Clutch Transmission (DDCT 6-Speed): Gearbox takes 1.9 L Tutela Transmission Gearforce; hydraulic actuation unit takes Tutela CS Speed hydraulic fluid.
factual_data.brake_and_clutch_fluid: Brake and hydraulic clutch system: Uses Mopar DOT 4 brake fluid meeting SAE J1704. Inspect every oil change, replace every 2 years or 24,000 miles.
factual_data.fuel_requirements: 1.4L Turbo MultiAir: 91 Octane Premium (R+M/2) is recommended for optimal performance, fuel economy, and full turbo boost. 87 Octane Regular is acceptable under normal driving, but the PCM retards ignition timing if knock is detected. Fuel tank capacity: 15.8 US Gallons (60 Liters).
factual_data.fuse_box_locations: Power Distribution Center (PDC) main underhood fuse box is on the driver's side of the engine compartment next to the battery. Interior cabin fuse box (Body Control Module / BCM) is located under the driver's side dashboard to the left of the steering column.
factual_data.battery_specifications: 12-Volt Group 48 / H6 AGM or flooded battery, 600 Cold Cranking Amps (CCA) minimum. The battery sensor (IBS) on the negative terminal monitors state-of-charge for the smart alternator.
factual_data.common_dtc_codes: P0299: Turbo Underboost (often sticky wastegate arm or torn diverter valve). P1066-P1069: MultiAir actuator cylinder signal errors (often low oil level or clogged micro-screen). P0300-P0304: Cylinder misfire (check NGK spark plugs and coil packs first).

guidelines: When Dad asks about maintenance, fluids, capacities, tire pressures, or troubleshooting, directly cite these exact OEM Dart specifications from the in-dash library.
